# Orvelline Passes API documentation

The Orvelline Passes API lets travel agencies, employers and campus offices book regional
rail passes for their travellers. The current version is 2; version 1 was retired on
31 March 2026.

## Guides

- Authentication: send your key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request.
- Idempotent requests: https://docs.orvelline.example/v2/idempotent-requests
- Errors: https://docs.orvelline.example/v2/errors
- Troubleshooting: https://docs.orvelline.example/troubleshooting

## Reference (v2)

- Pass bookings: https://docs.orvelline.example/v2/reference/pass-bookings

## Legacy

- Version 1 reservations (retired): https://docs.orvelline.example/v1/reference/reservations

## What's new

- Changelog: https://docs.orvelline.example/changelog

The API's base URL is `https://api.orvelline.example`; the sandbox's is
`https://sandbox.orvelline.example`.
